title: Tabletop RPG Music - Filter & Importer
description:
The shared search, filter, and playlist import tool for Tabletop RPG Music premium content. Filter a growing library of RPG soundtrack music by mood, scene, setting, timbre, and type, preview tracks in-app, and import your selection straight into new or existing playlists, with seamless looping versions available for every track.

This module contains no music itself. It automatically detects installed Tabletop RPG Music premium content modules, such as the Patreon module and upcoming music packs, and presents their combined libraries in a single searchable window. It is installed automatically as a dependency of that premium content and does nothing on its own, so there is no need to install it directly unless prompted.

Music by Tabletop RPG Music: tabletoprpgmusic.com
